verdict.rationale: Capacities has a documented REST API for accessing, creating, and manipulating content (docs-33, docs-18) and an official MCP integration path is documented (capacities-probe-3), enabling headless read/write without the GUI. However, the MCP docs describe building a custom MCP client rather than a fully turnkey first-party MCP server, no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (probe-2 shows 404s), and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent actually reading and writing notes via these interfaces. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/schema for the REST API, confirmation of a ready-made first-party MCP server (vs custom client implementation), and independent hands-on evidence of successful headless read/write usage.
